legal_ref: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999 s.9-70; commencement s.1-2
quote: "The amount of GST on a taxable supply is 10% of the value of the taxable supply." (s.9-70); "This Act commences on 1 July 2000." (s.1-2)
source_title: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999, Compilation No. 96 (compilation date 1 January 2026), Federal Register of Legislation
notes: Single 10% rate; GST-free supplies (e.g. exports, basic food, most health and education) under Division 38. Registration turnover threshold under s.23-15: '$50,000; or such higher amount as the regulations specify' (non-profit bodies $100,000 or higher prescribed amount). GST revenue is distributed to the states.
